title: BRISTOL CITY FANS CHANT FOR MANAGER'S SACKING AS NORWICH WIN 5-0
description:
Five goals, five different scorers, and the home fans were booing by half-time.

Norwich won five-nil at Ashton Gate. Paris Maghoma, Harry Darling, Andre Brooks and Jovon Makama scored, and Mathias Kvistgaarden added a penalty. Very fair sharing. Bristol fans booed at half-time, and later they chanted for Michael Skubala to be sacked.

Skubala apologised and called the second half unacceptable. Honest, at least. It was Bristol City's fifth home league defeat of the season. Norwich, meanwhile, have scored nine goals in two successive away wins. They love an away day. Bristol City are struggling to enjoy a home one.
